reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which matches the expectation for a compliant finding — the paragraphs are returned unchanged.

The cited text supports compliance with the preferred position: 19.1 gives the professional and workmanlike plus conformance warranty; 19.2 gives ninety days for Deliverables (from the later of delivery or acceptance) and conformance for hosted Services throughout the subscription term (exceeding the 12-month software benchmark); 19.3 covers no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law; 19.4 supplies the re-perform/repair/replace and refund remedy ladder.

The disclaimer in 19.5 is confined to implied warranties and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties — no walk-away 'AS IS' risk.

The failed deterministic check is a phrasing artifact: the period is written out as 'ninety days' rather than numerically, so the ≥90-day threshold is in fact satisfied and the check should not override the substantive reading.
Rationale is accurate and cites the correct paragraphs; no over- or under-statement warranting a severity adjustment.
